objective: Sequential focused-task campaign to improve validated learning efficiency and higher-order quantitative-research capability.
process_conclusion: Concrete behavioral advantage in selection, causal magnitude unresolved. The frontier-first qualitative-priority selector produced a directed, non-redundant, decisively closed sequence of five signal-class cells (reversal, CSRS, volatility-targeting, momentum, breakout), each tested once with independent verification, and surfaced a genuine positive candidate (momentum, 7/10 REGIME_STABLE). The single documented opportunistic selection (37260572520) was reactive: its objective arrived from a queued receipt item and the frontier was only operationalized as a side-effect. This audit also corrects the prior durable framing: LEARNING_STATE recorded the delta as RETAIN (verified), but the causal claim is not verified by controlled comparison, so the calibrated judgment is RETAIN (behaviorally supported; causally unverified).
research_conclusion: VERIFIED_NEGATIVE_RESULT; PRIOR_MOMENTUM_POSITIVE_EVIDENCE_INVALIDATED; COST_ROBUSTNESS=NO_BASELINE_EDGE. The corrected momentum signal produces no uniformly positive REGIME_STABLE edge at any lookback, and the predeclared cost grid therefore has no baseline edge to degrade: COST_ROBUST=0, COST_FRAGILE=0, NO_BASELINE_EDGE=10. The result is reproducible and independently verified. The process improvement is the correction of the shared signal formula plus signal-contract unit tests that would fail on a level-versus-return confusion.
unverified: Causal attribution is UNVERIFIED: no controlled counterfactual exists. The opportunistic and frontier-first regimes ran at different times with different tooling maturity, so a before/after comparison cannot isolate the selector as the cause of any efficiency gain.
No live trading, production execution, or external market-state inference was performed or verified.

The conservative cost level is exactly 2x the repository's realistic example cost model. It is a predeclared stress assumption, not an estimate of actual market impact or a forecast of execution costs.
The momentum SUPPORTED result is the strongest positive signal but is a single positive candidate; per the repository anti-gaming rules it cannot by itself prove a process-efficiency improvement.

The no-equivalent-re-tests property is partly tautological: the frontier table marks each cell closed with Next action None, so absence of re-tests is partly enforced by bookkeeping rather than independent evidence of selection quality.

The prior opportunistic baseline is effectively n=1 for hypothesis selection (37260572520) and was confounded with immature tooling; earlier activations (2026-10-02..04) were infrastructure-building, not signal-class hypothesis tests.
The result is simulation on one collected 10-asset universe (dataset yf-ohlcv-universe-2009-to-2026-10-03). It is not evidence about live-market profitability or execution availability.
The reversal and longer-horizon momentum artifacts were not re-run in this activation. They remain invalidated by the shared signal-definition defect and are UNVERIFIED under the corrected signal.
